In the kitchen area, chemicals used for cleaning and disinfecting were stored on open shelves in the preparation area and
were not adequately secured to prevent potential harm to the birds. The refrigerator also did not prevent contamination as
there were several spills and food detritus adhered to the back wall and bottom of the refrigerator. Supplies of food must

narrative:
3.150(e) 
   
Facilities, general. 
In the kitchen area, chemicals used for cleaning and disinfecting were stored on open shelves in the preparation area and 
were not adequately secured to prevent potential harm to the birds. The refrigerator also did not prevent contamination as 
there were several spills and food detritus adhered to the back wall and bottom of the refrigerator. Supplies of food must 
be stored in a manner that protects the supplies from deterioration, spoilage and contamination. 
 
Correct by 10 July 2026. 
 
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representative.
